# Khalil Hebachi

> Lead full-stack engineer (Laravel, React, PHP) building for clients worldwide since 2012.
> Leads a team of two developers and two testers on the StoragePal platform, built the SPS warehouse
> app end to end, and founded RavenClip, an AI news-to-video SaaS with paying customers.
> Open to senior, lead and founding engineer roles and freelance work: remote (GMT+1), or relocation
> to Europe, Canada or the US.
